audience: SaaS founders and finance teams that track MRR, churn and customers in Baremetrics

useCases.title: Compare MRR and ARR with an earlier date
useCases.text: Read the daily series of one metric, with a comparison to an earlier period. Read all key SaaS metrics for the same date range.

useCases.title: Find the customers behind a metric change
useCases.text: List the customers that contribute to one metric in a date range. Open one customer to read its details.

useCases.title: Break MRR down by plan
useCases.text: Split one metric by plan for a date range. List the plans to read their names and details.

useCases.title: Review cancellations and cohort retention
useCases.text: List subscription events such as cancels and downgrades in a date range. Read cohort retention by signup month.

useCases.title: Add a note for a price change
useCases.text: List the users, then add a note on a metric date, such as a price change. The note appears on the chart and changes no metric data.
